Manual; restricted to Tier-1 experimentally demonstrated CCN2 receptors (see T15)
Probabilities for custom pairs are not directly comparable to native CellChatDB pairs

Because CellChatDB (v2.2.0.9001) contains no CCN-family ligand-receptor interactions, a custom CCN2/CTGF interaction set was added comprising six pairs restricted to experimentally demonstrated CCN2 receptors (LRP1, alpha5beta1, syndecan-4, alphaVbeta3, alpha6beta1, TrkA). These interactions are flagged as custom throughout and are interpreted as exploratory rather than as part of the curated database.
